name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
eligibility: Low-income families identified under SECC database & Ayushman Card holders
benefit: Cashless secondary and tertiary health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year across empanelled government and private hospitals
documentation_required: Aadhaar Card; Ration Card / PM-JAY Letter; Family ID

name: Chief Minister Jan Arogya Yojana (UP)
eligibility: UP resident families not covered under PM-JAY (e.g. Antyodaya card holders and registered workers)
benefit: Cashless medical treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled government & private hospitals in UP
documentation_required: UP Domicile Certificate; Aadhaar Card; Antyodaya / Labour Card

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
eligibility: Pregnant women aged 19+ delivering at public health facilities or accredited private hospitals
benefit: Direct cash assistance of Rs 1400 (Rural) / Rs 1000 (Urban) + free transport & nutritional support
documentation_required: Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Maternal & Child Protection (MCP) Card

name: National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP)
eligibility: All individuals diagnosed with Tuberculosis in UP
benefit: Free diagnostic testing anti-TB medications and Rs 500/month nutritional incentive (Nikshay Poshan Yojana)
documentation_required: Aadhaar Card; Bank Account Details; Nikshay Portal Registration

name: UP Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana
eligibility: Children who lost parents or earning breadwinner due to illness/pandemics
benefit: Rs 4000 monthly financial aid free education and comprehensive healthcare coverage until age 18
documentation_required: Death Certificate of Parent; Income Certificate; Aadhaar Card

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child
benefit: Financial incentive of Rs 5000 in installments for maternal nutrition and healthcare compliance
documentation_required: Aadhaar Card; Mother-Child Protection Card; Bank Passbook

name: UP Mukhyamantri Free Dialysis Scheme
eligibility: UP residents with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) requiring chronic hemodialysis
benefit: 100% free hemodialysis sessions at designated government district hospitals & KGMU/Lohia Institute
documentation_required: Aadhaar Card; UP Domicile Certificate; Nephrologist Prescription

name: UP Emergency Ambulance Service (108 / 102)
eligibility: All UP citizens needing emergency medical transport or maternity transfer
benefit: 24/7 free emergency medical transport to nearest trauma center or district hospital

name: UP State Employees Cashless Medical Scheme
benefit: 100% cashless treatment at empanelled government and private medical institutions
documentation_required: State Health Card; Aadhaar Card; Employee ID
